english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent for being interested in an activity, topic, or plan.

exampleSentences.english: I’m very interested in learning Cantonese.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我對學廣東話好有興趣。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for being interested in or keen to do something.

exampleSentences.english: I’m really keen to learn pottery.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3 hok6 zing2 tou4 ngai6

english.note: Use 有興趣 when someone is engaged because they are interested in something.

exampleSentences.english: Are you engaged with this course?
exampleSentences.traditional: 你對呢個課程有興趣嗎？
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 deoi3 ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 jau5 hing3 ceoi3 maa3
